data.one_liner: CLI tool to scaffold clean architecture codebases with 19 state management options.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool and developer plugin designed to scaffold clean architecture projects in Flutter. It eliminates repetitive setup by generating modular features, screens, models, datasources, and repositories, supporting 19 different state management architectures.
use_when: Starting a new Flutter project and wanting to enforce a clean architecture structure quickly
Needing flexibility to choose from various state management libraries while maintaining a consistent project folder layout
avoid_when: Working on an existing codebase with a custom or non-standard folder structure
Not using clean architecture principles in your application design
strengths: Automates the creation of features, screens, models, repositories, and datasources
Provides bundle ID renaming and FVM support
weaknesses: Opinionated folder structure that may not suit every project's specific needs
CLI-based tool requiring terminal usage or dev dependency configuration
data.setup_notes: Can be added as a project dev dependency or activated globally via pub global activate.
